title: lcw-ltd-championship
label: Bob Yobbo Jr.
how: Beat Myrddin with the Yobbo Drop in the New Blood Rising tournament final, becoming the first LTD Champion.
note: Lost to Venom at an uncaptured show; dated only from Winter's Wrath's own video package, which calls it "a few weeks ago" as of 11 January 2002.

title: lcw-ltd-championship
label: Venom
how: Took the title from Bob Yobbo Jr.; the match itself is not in the surviving record.
note: Retained against Myrddin at Winter's Wrath (11 January 2002, event lcw-ltd-winters-wrath-2002-01). Lost the title before 19 March 2002; the match is not in the surviving record, presumed to be the uncaptured Steel City Carnage PPV of 22 February 2002.

title: lcw-ltd-championship
label: Myrddin
how: Took the title from Venom; the match itself is not in the surviving record, presumed to be the uncaptured Steel City Carnage PPV of 22 February 2002.
note: Retained against Ruthless Inc./HaVoC in a six-man defending both this title and the LTD Tag Team Championship at the 19 March 2002 Progression show (event lcw-ltd-progression-2002-03), billed under the aka Robert Tical. Still champion, billed against Headbuster, at the never-captured Genesis supercard.

title: lcw-ltd-progressive
label: Headbuster
how: First attested holding, already champion as of LTD's own 21 December 2001 front page; how he won the title is not in the surviving record.
note: Retained against Damien Diablo at Winter's Wrath (11 January 2002) and was billed defending against Barabbas on the 1 February 2002 card (results uncaptured). Lost the title to Scott Royal at an uncaptured show before 19 March 2002.

title: lcw-ltd-progressive
label: Scott Royal
how: Took the title from Headbuster; the match itself is not in the surviving record.
note: Struck a challenging Headbuster with this same belt to win a #1 contender's match by DQ at the 19 March 2002 Progression show — Headbuster advances to challenge for the LTD Championship at Genesis instead, and Royal keeps this title. Still champion, billed defending in a three-way against Humpy and Poltergeist, at the never-captured Genesis supercard.

title: lcw-ltd-lethal
label: Barabbas
how: First attested holding, already billed "STILL LTD Lethal Champion" at the 19 March 2002 Progression show; how or when he won the title is not in the surviving record.
note: Retained against Sloan Malice in a Hardcore Steel Cage at the 19 March 2002 Progression show (event lcw-ltd-progression-2002-03). Still champion, opponent unnamed, at the never-captured Genesis supercard.

title: lcw-ltd-tag-team
label: HaVoC (Bones, Brutakis & Maxx Vain)
how: First attested holding, billed champions entering the 19 March 2002 Progression show's own main event; how the titles were won — presumed the tag tournament seeded at Winter's Wrath, whose own final is not in the surviving record, possibly at the uncaptured Steel City Carnage PPV of 22 February 2002 — is not confirmed.
note: Billed on the card itself as plain "HaVoC" alongside Maxx Vain, and elsewhere in the same show's own commentary as "Ruthless Inc." — the same trio under both names.

title: lcw-ltd-tag-team
label: Baine and Parker Louis
how: Wrestling as Global Warning alongside Myrddin, won a six-man that also kept Myrddin's own LTD Championship; Baine and Myrddin scored simultaneous pinfalls on Bones and Maxx Vain.
note: Still champions, billed defending against a two-man "HaVoC (Bones and Brutakis)" without Maxx Vain, at the never-captured Genesis supercard.
